en-US.description: Screen capture and screen recording software from TechSmith.
en-US.longDescription: Snagit helps you quickly share information in a way that's easy to understand. Capture your screen and camera, add additional context and move work forward faster.
en-US.name: Snagit 2027
en-US.releaseNotes:
Feature Updates
Sharing to Camtasia Online
- Added a Create a Video option to the Move tool. Send a selected Step Capture or image to Camtasia Online for quick video creation.
- Images sent to Camtasia Online now include additional text and cursor information to help with video creation. Onboarding
- Updated the Welcome to Snagit image that opens by default and exposes several of Snagit's tools.
- Removed in-product tours from the welcome window on initial launch and from the Snagit Editor Learning Center.
Performance Improvements
- Improved performance of enhanced tooltips in Snagit Editor.
- Improved keyboard accessibility for Snagit Editor's customizable toolbar.
Updates for IT Administrators
- Updated Brotli to version 1.2.1 to address CVE-2026-111497.
- Fixed an issue where certain deployment configurations might have issues with installing new updates.
- Updated the Snagit Capture and Snagit Editor title bars to indicate when the user is running the app as an administrator.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where Snagit Capture might interfere with users shutting down or signing out of Windows.
- Fixed an issue where the Eraser tool did not completely remove data in certain circumstances.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when hiding the Snagit Capture window in certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue where changing the color of multiple Arrow objects would also change other properties.
